svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Shared structures stored inside documents · These are not separate MongoDB collections
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
PDF publicId ends in .pdf. Delivery URLs stay inside the backend.
Removed is a campaign audit decision.
The approval endpoint accepts only approved/rejected; removal has its own
Capture values when a generation attempt is reserved. Freeze after successful
Names, location and activity dates remain stable when live profiles later change.
draft | pending | approved | rejected | cancelled | completed | removed
Environment · Food Support · Community Support · Education · Humanitarian Support · Other
Country = BH. Campaign timezone = Asia/Bahrain. Store timestamps in UTC; display activity times in Bahrain time (UTC+3).
All schemas accept normal Unicode text; the interface and certificate template are English. Generated IDs/timestamps are managed by the backend.
Certificate state: processing | issued | failed. pdfAsset and issuedAt are absent until issuance. Optional subdocuments use _id: false.
